title: cymbopogon setifer
intro: Cymbopogon setifer, commonly known as Java citronella, is a species of grass native to Indonesia. This plant has been widely used for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate stress. The therapeutic actions of Cymbopogon setifer include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its uses in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include citronellal, geraniol, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
